summary: Renderer metrics expose metadata-only cache and pool snapshots; controlled-load records before-after deltas and never treats a cold label alone as proof.
invariants: Public renderer telemetry contains counters, versions, and Chrome digest only; no slide content or paths.
Controlled-load records before-after cache deltas and rejects renderer identity drift.
Cold receipt validation remains distinct from observed cache-state proof.
forbidden: Do not expose HTML, QIDs, asset URLs, profiles, or filesystem paths in renderer metrics.
Do not claim cold state from a receipt label alone.
